entries.zh: 互相谦让；彼此一同（相兼）
entries.en: both together; mutually yielding each to the other
both; each other (though not in accord)
to frighten, intimidate; to coax or cheat

entries.zh: 哄骗：以声势恐吓而行骗
entries.en: to frighten with cries in order to deceive; to cheat by intimidation

entries.zh: 慌张、惊惶失措；以吵闹相吓
entries.en: flustered, frightened; to frighten by quarreling
entries.notes: 汉字「慌张」与西语 amedrentar riñendo（吵闹恐吓）语义侧重不同，按四栏取慌张为主义。

entries.zh: 威吓、恐吓（字面「雕」，此处作恐吓义用）
entries.notes: 「雕」作 amenaçar 义为方言借字用法，字形与释义关联需存疑。

entries.en: to let out a threat; to threaten someone
entries.notes: 「放雕」为复合恐吓义，字面组合与现代语义不直通，依四栏定夺。

entries.zh: 攻讦：以对方隐私或过错相要挟、揭短
entries.en: to reproach or expose another's fault; to threaten him with what he has done
entries.notes: 西语原句拼写残乱（abelin quido 当为 sabe/ha hecho 类讹写），释义依「訐」字本义推定。

entries.en: luxuriant, flourishing; pleasant as a meadow
concord, amity; to live in friendship
entries.notes: 封存件标注「疑:睦/陆」，第二字字形存疑但音义与和睦相合。

entries.zh: 和合：和好相处、结为朋友
entries.en: to be friends, to be in accord; friendly union

entries.zh: 和气：彼此顺遂对方心意、融洽
entries.en: amicable, congenial; friends who gratify each other's will

entries.zh: 和谐：如夫妻般情投意合
entries.en: harmonious; in accord like a married couple

entries.zh: 和顺：彼此不相违逆、温顺相合
entries.en: agreeable, compliant; friends who do not contradict one another

entries.zh: 和同：心意相通、如乐音相和
entries.en: harmonious agreement; friends of one mind, as in music
